name: Bácsbokod (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, red and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bácsbokod (a blue shield with a white and yellow plant between ears of grain) above a yellow scroll inscribed Bácsbokod.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
